_about: When each feed schedule is closed, inferred from the feeds' own rounds and never from a pinned calendar (DECISION, tracker/LESSONS.md 2026-09-18). Time inside a closed span does not count toward a feed's age: a gap that matches it is expected, and the last round stands as the mark. Any other gap past heartbeat + margin is stale and blocks. That includes a market holiday, which this file does not model (planning/PLAN.md section 13). Proposed by `python -m fund.adapters.chain_4663 --sessions`, reviewed, and written here by hand; nothing derives it at cycle time.

derivation._labels_note: The schedules a closed span is inferred for. Crypto feeds run every day, so none is proposed for them.
derivation._history_note: Every round back to the feed's first: a year is longer than any feed has existed, and the walk stops at a scale break (the launch regime, in other units) or at the phase start.
derivation._guard_note: The never-observed span is shrunk by the guard on each side, then to whole grid marks, so a round seconds past an observed extreme does not contradict it. Shrinking counts less time as closed, which fails closed.
derivation._min_weekends_note: The decision asked for a pattern, not one weekend: fewer complete weeks showing the span and the proposal is refused.
